units.source_text: 四月朔日更衣，始穿夏服。

en.t: On the first day of the fourth month, they changed clothes and began wearing summer garments.

units.source_text: 此时人心顿感轻快，天色也不知不觉地变得异常明朗。

en.t: At this time, people's hearts suddenly felt light, and the sky too, almost unnoticed, became unusually bright.

units.source_text: 源氏闲暇无事，常常饮酒作乐，悠游度日。

en.t: Genji had leisure and no pressing duties, and often spent his days drinking, amusing himself, and taking his ease.

units.source_text: 玉鬘收到各方情书，越来越多。

en.t: Tamakazura received love letters from all directions, and they grew more and more numerous.

units.source_text: 源氏看见此事果然不出所料，颇感兴趣，常常到玉鬘那里去，查看她的情书。

en.t: Seeing that this was just as he had expected, Genji found it quite interesting and often went to Tamakazura to look through her love letters.

units.source_text: 见有应该答复的，劝她答复。

en.t: When he saw one that deserved an answer, he urged her to reply.

units.source_text: 玉鬘则含情不语，颇有难色。

en.t: Tamakazura, however, remained silent with feelings unspoken and looked rather troubled.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王求爱未久，便已焦灼不堪，在情书中申恨诉怨，源氏看了吃吃地笑个不住。

en.t: The Prince Minister of War had not been courting her for long before he became unbearably impatient, pouring out grievances and complaints in his letters, and Genji could not stop chuckling as he read them.

units.source_text: 后来对玉鬘说：“在许多亲王之中，我对这位皇弟早就格外亲昵。

en.t: Later he said to Tamakazura, "Among the many princes, I have long been especially close to this imperial brother.

units.source_text: 只是风流之事，一向绝不谈起。

en.t: Only, when it came to matters of romance and refinement, we never spoke of them at all.

units.source_text: 如今已入中年，却给我看到了如此热烈的情书，倒很有趣，但也怪可怜的。

en.t: Now that he has reached middle age, seeing such passionate love letters from him is rather amusing, but also strangely pitiable.
You really must send him a reply.

units.source_text: 凡是略解风情的女子，都知道除了这位亲王之外，世间更无可与交谈之人。

en.t: Any woman with even a slight understanding of romance knows that, apart from this prince, there is no one else in the world worth conversing with.
He truly is a refined and romantic gentleman."

units.source_text: 他想用这话来打动这青年女子的心，然而玉鬘只觉得难以为情。

en.t: He hoped to move the young woman's heart with these words, but Tamakazura only felt embarrassed and ill at ease.
